qe: A vendor sold 15 toys for ₹3000 and gained a profit of 25%. How many toys should he sell for ₹2816 to make a profit of 10%?
qh: एक विक्रेता ने ₹3000 में 15 खिलौने बेचे और 25% का लाभ प्राप्त किया। 10% का लाभ कमाने के लिए उसे ₹2816 में कितने खिलौने बेचने चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: 1 khilaune ka pehla SP nikalein:
SP1 per toy = 3000 / 15 = ₹200.
Step 2: 25% labh (1/4) ==> CP : SP1 = 4 : 5.
5 units = ₹200 ==> 1 unit = ₹40 ==> CP per toy = 4 * 40 = ₹160.
Step 3: Naya SP 10% labh par (10% = 1/10) ==> CP : SP2 = 10 : 11.
10 units = ₹160 ==> 1 unit = ₹16 ==> SP2 per toy = 11 * 16 = ₹176.
Step 4: Khilauno ki sankhya = Kul Rashi / SP2 per toy = 2816 / 176 = 16 toys.
Atah sahi vikalp  16 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base / Standard Formula Method):
Step 1: Formula: [P1 / (Q1 * (100 + r1)%)] = [P2 / (Q2 * (100 + r2)%)]
Step 2: Maan rakhne par:
3000 / (15 * 125) = 2816 / (Q2 * 110)
200 / 125 = 2816 / (110 * Q2)
8 / 5 = 2816 / (110 * Q2)
Step 3: Q2 = (2816 * 5) / (8 * 110) = (352 * 5) / 110 = 1760 / 110 = 16 toys.
Atah sahi uttar '16' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A person bought 7 apples for ₹3. At what price he should sell 100 apples to get the profit of 33%?
qh: एक व्यक्ति ने ₹3 में 7 सेब खरीदे। 33% का लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए उसे 100 सेब किस मूल्य पर बेचने चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: 100 seb ka CP nikalein:
7 seb ka CP = ₹3 ==> 100 seb ka CP = (3 / 7) * 100 = ₹300/7.
Step 2: 33% labh par SP ratio:
CP : SP = 100 : 133.
100 units = 300 / 7 ==> 1 unit = 3 / 7.
Step 3: SP (133 units) = 133 * (3 / 7) = 19 * 3 = ₹57.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹57 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: 1 seb ka CP = ₹3/7.
Step 2: 33% labh par 1 seb ka SP = (3 / 7) * 1.33 = (3 / 7) * (133 / 100) = (3 * 19) / 100 = 57 / 100 = ₹0.57.
Step 3: 100 seb ka SP = 100 * 0.57 = ₹57.
Atah sahi uttar '₹57' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: By selling 3 dozen oranges for ₹405, a trader losses 25%. How many oranges should he sell for ₹288 if he needs to earn a profit of 20% in the transaction?
qh: ₹405 में 3 दर्जन संतरे बेचने पर, एक व्यापारी को 25% की हानि होती है। यदि उसे लेन-देन में 20% का लाभ अर्जित करना है, तो उसे ₹288 में कितने संतरे बेचने चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: 3 dozen = 36 santare.
36 santaro ka SP1 = ₹405 ==> 1 santare ka SP1 = 405 / 36 = 45 / 4 = ₹11.25.
Step 2: 25% loss (1/4) ==> CP : SP1 = 4 : 3.
3 units = 45 / 4 ==> 1 unit = 15 / 4 ==> CP = 4 * (15 / 4) = ₹15.
Step 3: 20% labh (1/5) ==> CP : SP2 = 5 : 6.
5 units = ₹15 ==> 1 unit = ₹3 ==> SP2 = 6 * 3 = ₹18 per orange.
Step 4: Santaro ki sankhya = 288 / 18 = 16 oranges.
Atah sahi vikalp  16 hai.

Method 2 (Standard Formula Method):
Step 1: P1 / (Q1 * (100 - L1)%) = P2 / (Q2 * (100 + P2)%)
Step 2: 405 / (36 * 75) = 288 / (Q2 * 120)
405 / 2700 = 288 / (120 * Q2)
3 / 20 = 288 / (120 * Q2)
Step 3: Q2 = (288 * 20) / (3 * 120) = 288 / 18 = 16 oranges.
Atah sahi uttar '16' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: By selling 32 oranges in one rupee, a man losses 40%. How many for one rupee should he sell in order to gain 20%?
qh: एक रुपये में 32 संतरे बेचने पर एक व्यक्ति को 40% की हानि होती है। 20% का लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए उसे एक रुपये में कितने संतरे बेचने चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Jab kul rashi (₹1) saman ho, toh mulya (price) aur matra (quantity) ek dusre ke vyutkramanuupati (inversely proportional) hote hain.
Step 2: Mulya ka anupat: Price1 : Price2 = (100 - 40)% : (100 + 20)% = 60 : 120 = 1 : 2.
Step 3: Matra ka anupat (Quantity ratio): Q1 : Q2 = 2 : 1.
Step 4: Pehle ki matra (2 units) = 32 santare ==> 1 unit = 16 santare.
Nayi matra (Q2) = 1 unit = 16 oranges.
Atah sahi vikalp  16 hai.

Method 2 (Standard Formula Method):
Step 1: P1 / (Q1 * %1) = P2 / (Q2 * %2)
Step 2: 1 / (32 * 60) = 1 / (Q2 * 120)
32 * 60 = Q2 * 120
Step 3: Q2 = (32 * 60) / 120 = 32 / 2 = 16 oranges.
Atah sahi uttar '16' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: After selling 4 article for ₹1 a person incurred loss of 4%. If he had sold 3 articles for ₹1 his profit percentage would be?
qh: ₹1 में 4 वस्तुएं बेचने पर एक व्यक्ति को 4% की हानि होती है। यदि उसने ₹1 में 3 वस्तुएं बेची होतीं, तो उसका लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होता?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Rashi (₹1) saman hai, isliye Mulya (Price) aur Matra (Quantity) ek dusre ke ulte hote hain:
Q1 : Q2 = 4 : 3 ==> Price1 : Price2 = 3 : 4.
Step 2: 4% hani ka matlab Price1 = 100% - 4% = 96%.
3 units = 96% ==> 1 unit = 32%.
Step 3: Price2 = 4 units = 4 * 32% = 128%.
Step 4: Naya Profit% = 128% - 100% = 28% profit.
Atah sahi vikalp  28% hai.

Method 2 (Standard Formula Method):
Step 1: 1 / (4 * 96) = 1 / (3 * X)
3 * X = 4 * 96 ==> X = (4 * 96) / 3 = 4 * 32 = 128%.
Step 2: Labh pratishat = 128% - 100% = 28%.
Atah sahi uttar '28%' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: On selling 70 articles for ₹160 a person incurred loss of 20%. How many articles he should sell for ₹96 to earn profit of 20%.
qh: ₹160 में 70 वस्तुएं बेचने पर एक व्यक्ति को 20% की हानि होती है। 20% का लाभ अर्जित करने के लिए उसे ₹96 में कितनी वस्तुएं बेचनी चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Pehle case me 1 vastu ka SP1 = 160 / 70 = ₹16/7.
Step 2: 20% hani (1/5) ==> CP : SP1 = 5 : 4.
4 units = 16/7 ==> 1 unit = 4/7 ==> CP = 5 * (4/7) = ₹20/7.
Step 3: Naye case me 20% labh (1/5) ==> CP : SP2 = 5 : 6.
5 units = 20/7 ==> 1 unit = 4/7 ==> SP2 = 6 * (4/7) = ₹24/7 per article.
Step 4: Vastuo ki sankhya = Kul Rashi / SP2 = 96 / (24/7) = (96 * 7) / 24 = 4 * 7 = 28 articles.
Atah sahi vikalp  28 hai.

Method 2 (Standard Formula Method):
Step 1: P1 / (Q1 * %1) = P2 / (Q2 * %2)
160 / (70 * 80) = 96 / (Q2 * 120)
Step 2: 160 / 5600 = 96 / (120 * Q2)
1 / 35 = 4 / (5 * Q2)
Step 3: 5 * Q2 = 4 * 35 = 140 ==> Q2 = 140 / 5 = 28 articles.
Atah sahi uttar '28' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: By selling 18 table fans for ₹11,664 a man incurs a loss of 10%. How many fans should be sell for ₹17,424 to earn 10% profit?
qh: ₹11,664 में 18 टेबल पंखे बेचने पर एक व्यक्ति को 10% की हानि होती है। 10% लाभ कमाने के लिए ₹17,424 में कितने पंखे बेचे जाने चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: 1 pankhe ka pehla SP1 = 11,664 / 18 = ₹648.
Step 2: 10% hani (1/10) ==> CP : SP1 = 10 : 9.
9 units = 648 ==> 1 unit = 72 ==> CP = 10 * 72 = ₹720.
Step 3: 10% labh par naya SP2 (10 : 11):
10 units = 720 ==> SP2 = 11 * 72 = ₹792 per fan.
Step 4: Pankho ki sankhya = 17,424 / 792 = 22 fans.
Atah sahi vikalp  22 hai.

Method 2 (Standard Formula Method):
Step 1: P1 / (Q1 * (100 - L1)%) = P2 / (Q2 * (100 + P2)%)
11664 / (18 * 90) = 17424 / (Q2 * 110)
Step 2: 11664 / 1620 = 17424 / (110 * Q2)
7.2 = 17424 / (110 * Q2)
Step 3: Q2 = 17424 / (7.2 * 110) = 17424 / 792 = 22 fans.
Atah sahi uttar '22' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.
